component.name: Baseplate
component.summary: Build, design and sync Roblox systems, with an AI assistant

description.p: Baseplate is a dark studio for building Roblox systems (an inventory, a shop, a quest log). Each system is its own project with server, client and shared scripts, GUIs and notes, and it live-syncs into Roblox Studio with Rojo.

ul.li: AI assistant: Claude, ChatGPT (your own API key) or Ollama (free, on your computer)
Apply the assistant's code to a file, insert it, or save it as a new script
GUI preview on desktop, laptop, tablet and phone screen sizes
Figma tab: design a frame, import it as a Roblox ScreenGui, update it later
Live sync to Roblox Studio, or build a place file
No account, no ads, no tracking

description.p: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Roblox Corporation, Figma, Inc., Anthropic or OpenAI.
Roblox Vault is now Baseplate: new name, new icon and a dark studio redesign.

ul.li: AI assistant docked on the right: Claude, ChatGPT or Ollama
Systems and files sidebar with grouped files, status bar and log panel
Projects from Roblox Vault are copied in on first start

description.p: Fixes "Figma said no" when connecting Figma. Connecting no longer sends a test request, and Figma errors now say what went wrong.

ul.li: Projects with scripts, GUIs and notes, synced to Studio with Rojo
Figma tab with one-click GUI import and updates
GUI preview at four screen sizes
Uninstall button that removes the app and all its data
